description_en: Modifies the attributes of an egress proxy gateway instance
description_zh: 修改出口代理网关实例属性
name: UpdateEgressProxyGatewayAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 出口代理网关实例的 ID
parameters.name: egress_proxy_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the egress proxy gateway instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
出口代理网关实例的名称。

长度为 2~128 个字符，必须以英文字母或中文开头，可包含中文、英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: egress_proxy_gateway_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the egress proxy gateway instance.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
出口代理网关实例的描述信息。

长度为 2~256 个字符，可包含中文、英文字母、数字、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the default egress IP pool
parameters.name: default_egress_proxy_ip_pool_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the private CA certificate.

If TlsInterceptMode is set to enable, this parameter is required.
If TlsInterceptMode is set to disable, do not specify this parameter
fields.help_zh:
私有 CA 证书的 ID。

当 TlsInterceptMode 取值为 enable 时，该参数必填；
当 TlsInterceptMode 取值为 disable 时，请勿指定该参数
fields.name: private_ca_certificate_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable TLS interception. Valid values:

enable: enables TLS interception.

disable: disables TLS interception
fields.help_zh:
是否开启 TLS 拦截。取值：

enable：开启 TLS 拦截。

disable：关闭 TLS 拦截
fields.name: tls_intercept_mode

parameters.help_en: The TLS interception settings of the egress proxy gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 出口代理网关实例的 TLS 拦截配置
parameters.name: tls_intercept_properties

fields.help_en:
The listener port number.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
fields.help_zh:
监听端口号。

取值范围：1~65535
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The protocol type of the listener. Valid values:

HTTP: HTTP.

HTTPS: HTTPS
fields.help_zh:
监听的协议类型。取值：

HTTP：HTTP 协议。

HTTPS：HTTPS 协议
fields.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The list of listeners to add.

Listeners in the same gateway instance cannot use the same port
parameters.help_zh:
新增的监听配置列表。

同一网关实例内不允许出现端口重复的监听
parameters.name: add_listener_properties

fields.help_en:
The listener port number.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
fields.help_zh:
监听端口号。

取值范围：1~65535
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The protocol type of the listener. Valid values:

HTTP: HTTP.

HTTPS: HTTPS
fields.help_zh:
监听的协议类型。取值：

HTTP：HTTP 协议。

HTTPS：HTTPS 协议
fields.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The list of listeners to remove
parameters.name: remove_listener_properties

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the request but does not update the gateway information. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.

false (default): performs a normal request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会更新网关信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 HTTP 2xx 状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

Note If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token
